title: Extract the _HebrewTermsOff/_track/_perTrackOverrides test scaffolding duplicated across 3 track-management test files
rule: Fowler duplication lens (Extract Class/shared test helper) — cf. test/helpers/drift_memory.dart precedent
why: All three files independently redeclare identical private scaffolding: class _HebrewTermsOff extends UseHebrewTerms, a CurriculumTrack _track({...}) fixture builder, a _perTrackOverrides(...) helper, _MockStackRouter/_FakePageRouteInfo mocks, and _settle/_teardown pump helpers — none imported from a shared file, unlike DB helpers which already live centrally in test/helpers/drift_memory.dart. The copies have already drifted: track_management_body_and_order_l1_test.dart's _perTrackOverrides gained an extra chazaraEnabled parameter that the other two copies don't have, so a future change to CurriculumTrack's shape or to the per-track override set requires editing three files in lockstep, and it is easy to update one copy and miss the others (classic shotgun surgery).
recommendation: Extract a shared test helper file (e.g. test/features/tracks/setup/helpers/track_hub_test_helpers.dart) providing _track(), _perTrackOverrides(), _HebrewTermsOff, _MockStackRouter, _FakePageRouteInfo, and the settle/teardown pump helpers; import it from all three call sites.
acceptance_criteria: _HebrewTermsOff, _track(), _perTrackOverrides(), and the mock classes are defined once and imported by the three test files
No behavioral change to existing passing tests
